newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PCI expects to return to profit in 1998.
newsitem.headline: PCI expects to return to profit in 1998.

text.p: Printed circuit-board maker PCI Ltd said it expected to return to profit in 1998.
The company said in a statement received by Reuters on Monday that it had faced difficulties due to the global slowdown in the electronics industry and also in its telecommunications sector.
PCI earlier said it made a net loss of Singapore $21.94 million in the financial year ended June 30, 1996.
"Our customers, faced with poor demand and oversupply for their products, made substantial cuts in orders," it said.

"The group will continue its effort to control cost and streamline the organisation structure to meet the challenges ahead," PCI said. "Barring unforeseen circumstances, the directors expect the group to return to profitability in 1998."
